style: Dark campaign screening-room finish with hard editorial geometry: black media plate, paper-white condensed typography, signal-red accents, sharp corners, no shadows, no gradients, and deliberate type-over-subject occlusion. Organic runner motion contrasts with rigid deterministic typographic cadence.

customize.reuse_scope: Reuse the catalog block's paused GSAP timeline, split-word and split-letter structure, clip-safe entrance mechanics, and deterministic seek behavior. Adapt it to one full-duration composition over the locked MP4 plate.

content.shot_brief: Across one uninterrupted 5.041667-second plate, the supplied New York Comfy runner warm-up remains pixel-for-pixel and is the only generative motion. Four Six Caps edge strips move continuously as a perimeter marquee while RUN and WILD arrive in staggered, forceful word-and-letter beats; THE CITY RUNS WITH YOU follows as the localized response, then the fictional-route disclaimer locks into a production-proof final hold. The single dominant motion idea is rigid typographic cadence set against the runner's organic warm-up, with every overlay deterministic, editable, sharp-edged, and unshadowed.

source_media.treatment: Preserve pixel-for-pixel; no crop, retime, color treatment, replacement, or generated extension.

typography.display_face: Arial Narrow, Helvetica Neue Condensed, system sans-serif
typography.headline: RUN WILD

perimeter_marquee.copy: NIKE.COM — YOUR ONLY LIMIT IS YOU. JUST DO IT.
perimeter_marquee.track_construction: Each strip contains two adjacent identical copies of one repeated phrase track. Animate exactly one copy length and wrap modulo 50 percent so the seam is never exposed.
perimeter_marquee.constraints: Super-thin, highly condensed, single-line strips clipped to their own rails; no shadow, glow, gradient, acceleration, pause, or collision response. Opposing edge pairs travel in opposite directions for the full 121-frame composition.

layout.coordinate_space: Absolute pixels from the 1204 x 1720 top-left origin.

avoid_zones.rule: No headline, support copy, disclaimer, or marquee may enter this region at any frame.
No legible copy may cover the runner's chest, abdomen, or shorts; moving limbs may cross empty negative space only.

motion_system.timebase: Frame-indexed at 24 fps. All GSAP positions are absolute seconds derived from integer frames; all tweens use explicit fromTo values and a paused master timeline.
motion_system.dominant_motif: Mechanical staggered type stops against continuous organic runner motion.
motion_system.pattern_interrupt: At frame 60, change only scale and cadence: the large two-line slam stops and the compact supporting line begins its word reveal.

primitives.landing: One deterministic four-frame y settle from -8 px to 0; no shake, bounce, rotation, or elastic overshoot.

primitives.emphasis: CITY shifts once to #FF1616 at frame 72; YOU remains paper white.

primitives.target: FICTIONAL DEMO ROUTE · REPLACE BEFORE PRODUCTION

primitives.details: Use the exact axes and 0-to-50-percent translations in perimeter_marquee.strips_spec; no opacity animation.

motion_system.exits: None. Completed text remains locked and readable through frame 120; the source plate and marquee continue without a fade to black.

accessibility.reduced_motion: Freeze marquee at its frame-0 position and show all localized copy in its final layout; do not alter the locked source media.
accessibility.contrast: All type remains #F5F5F2 or #FF1616 against #080808 negative space; never place copy over the face or torso envelopes.

scenes.motion: Reveal RUN through a hard vertical crop, then stagger its letters two frames apart into a precise stop; no soft easing or decorative bounce.
Keep RUN locked while WILD slams in on the opposing axis with a tightly staggered letter entrance and a four-frame mechanical settle.
